app.name: Imposter Party
onboarding.1.title: Everyone's in. One is lying.
onboarding.1.body: Pass the phone around. Everyone sees the same secret word — except one. That's the imposter among you.
onboarding.2.title: Drop a clue, don't blow it
onboarding.2.body: Your turn: hint at the word without saying it. Wink at those who know, fool the imposter. The imposter just bluffs.
onboarding.3.title: Talk, suspect, expose
onboarding.3.body: Debate, then point at the suspect. Nail the right one and you win; let the imposter slip away and the round is theirs.
tutorial.1.title: Pick your pack
tutorial.1.body: Choose themes — or tap Surprise me and let the app deal the cards.
tutorial.2.title: Hold to peek
tutorial.2.body: Your card stays sealed. Hold your finger to open it — release and it closes. Nobody peeks over your shoulder.
tutorial.3.title: Take your turn
tutorial.3.body: The app calls each player in order. Drop one clever clue — clear for allies, confusing for the imposter.
tutorial.4.title: Accuse & expose
tutorial.4.body: Debate, then point at the suspect and reveal the truth.
tutorial.4.warning: If the imposter guesses the word before time runs out, they win instantly

howto.classic.1.title: Classic: secret word
howto.classic.1.body: Pick theme packs. Everyone except the imposter sees the same secret word.
howto.classic.2.title: Hold to peek your role
howto.classic.2.body: Your card stays sealed. Hold to open — release and it snaps shut so nobody peeks.
howto.classic.3.title: Describe without saying it
howto.classic.3.body: On your turn give one clue. Help the crew… or bluff if you're the imposter.
howto.classic.4.title: Debate, then accuse
howto.classic.4.body: Talk it out and vote. Find the imposter and the crew wins the round.
howto.classic.4.warning: If the imposter guesses the secret word first, they win instantly.
howto.chain.1.title: Clue Chain: one shared line
howto.chain.1.body: Pick packs as usual. This mode builds ONE word chain — each player adds a single link.
howto.chain.2.title: Hold to peek your role
howto.chain.2.body: Most players see the secret word. The imposter must invent links that still sound natural.
howto.chain.3.title: Add exactly one word
howto.chain.3.body: When it's your turn, say only ONE word that connects to the words before you. No sentences.
howto.chain.4.title: Find the weak link
howto.chain.4.body: Forced or random words stick out. Debate who broke the chain, then vote.
howto.chain.4.warning: Listen for jumps that don't fit the chain — that's often the imposter.
howto.doubleAgent.1.title: Double Agent: two words
howto.doubleAgent.1.body: Pick packs. Crew gets the real word. Imposters get a convincing decoy — no IMPOSTER label.
howto.doubleAgent.2.title: Hold to peek your word
howto.doubleAgent.2.body: Everyone thinks they know the word. You won't be told if yours is fake — trust the card.
howto.doubleAgent.3.title: Clue YOUR word only
howto.doubleAgent.3.body: Describe the word on your card. If it's the decoy, your details will slowly clash with the crew.
howto.doubleAgent.4.title: Hunt the mismatch
howto.doubleAgent.4.body: Spot who keeps describing a different thing. Accuse the double agent before they blend in.
howto.doubleAgent.4.warning: There is no red IMPOSTER card — the decoy word is the trap.
howto.emoji.1.title: Emoji Mode: no talking
howto.emoji.1.body: Pick packs. Clues must be emoji-only — no spoken words, no spelling the secret.
howto.emoji.2.title: Hold to peek your role
howto.emoji.2.body: Crew sees the word. The imposter must bluff with emojis that still feel on-theme.
howto.emoji.3.title: Show emoji clues only
howto.emoji.3.body: On your turn share emojis (another phone or act them out). Letters and saying the word are banned.
howto.emoji.4.title: Read the emoji tells
howto.emoji.4.body: Weird or too-safe emoji picks give people away. Debate, then vote out the imposter.
howto.emoji.4.warning: Speaking or spelling the word breaks the mode — stick to emojis.
howto.rapid.1.title: Rapid: countdown every turn
howto.rapid.1.body: Pick packs. Each clue turn has a short timer — about 12 seconds, then it auto-skips.
howto.rapid.2.title: Hold to peek your role
howto.rapid.2.body: Same sealed card. Peek fast — the round won't wait for long debates mid-turn.
howto.rapid.3.title: One clue before time's up
howto.rapid.3.body: When the timer starts, spit out one clue. Hit zero and the phone moves on automatically.
howto.rapid.4.title: Short debate, fast vote
howto.rapid.4.body: After the rapid loop, talk briefly and accuse. Hesitation is a clue too.
howto.rapid.4.warning: No time to overthink — snap answers can expose the imposter.
howto.drawing.1.title: Drawing: no words, just ink
howto.drawing.1.body: Pick packs. Hints are drawings on a shared canvas — talking the word isn't allowed.
howto.drawing.2.title: Hold to peek your role
howto.drawing.2.body: Crew sees the word. The imposter must invent a doodle that somehow still fits.
howto.drawing.3.title: One stroke, then pass
howto.drawing.3.body: On your turn draw a single-stroke hint, then hand the phone to the next player.
howto.drawing.4.title: Study the doodles
howto.drawing.4.body: Awkward or overly safe drawings stand out. Vote to expose the imposter.
howto.drawing.4.warning: Writing letters or the word itself is cheating — draw only.
